## Projects

### Development Knowledge Vault

Stack: Next.js, Vercel, MCP, Clerk, OAuth, TypeScript, Markdown

Built a Vercel-hosted MCP server that exposes markdown engineering patterns as tools (`list_patterns`, `get_pattern`), with dual auth on one URL—Clerk OAuth for cloud clients and an optional shared-secret Bearer for local/curl—so Cursor, Gemini Spark, and other MCP clients can pull operational preferences and prior solutions at request time.

- Production MCP endpoint serving a curated pattern corpus (deploy, auth, evals, PII, multi-agent, YAML SOT, and related practices).
- Dual-acceptance auth documented and shipped so the same URL works for OAuth clients and Bearer-configured IDE/curl without smart surface detection.
- Personal Cursor skill (`knowledge-vault`) that steers agents to query the vault before inventing process.
